verdicts.reason: A: both decorative circles are shrunk and float fully inside the canvas instead of bleeding off the edges, so the original's framing is lost; the teal circle awkwardly touches the can's right green dot, there is a lot of dead space above the logo, and the legal line sits on the bottom-left circle. B keeps the original's edge-bleeding circles and layering (logo and can over the teal circle), so it is more faithful, but the CTA is jammed right under the headline, and the legal line floats mid-canvas over the blue circle with an empty band below it.
